title: Design System: Monk app - Side by Side

display.purpose: Desktop own-faction heading; responsive sizes are recorded in DESIGN.md, not a kit-wide display ramp.

headline.purpose: App sections and non-playing HUD headings.

body.purpose: Instructions and operational copy, capped at 70ch.

label.purpose: Form labels; buttons and summaries have their own weight 650.

caption.purpose: QR/radar captions and distance reference notes.

metadata.purpose: Faction labels and supporting location information.

motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Button state color only; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. No app splash or gameplay animation dependency.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Ink-led action; inline SVG copies the shipped Tabler outline circle-plus geometry. CSS variables stay live-bound with standalone fallbacks.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button"><svg class="ds-action-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 18 0a9 9 0 0 0 -18 0"/><path d="M9 12h6"/><path d="M12 9v6"/></svg>Create room</button>

components.name: Room-code field
components.description: Labeled code input with linked helper text; aria-invalid changes the stroke. Error text belongs inline and entered values persist.
components.html: Enter the eight-character code from your host.
components.css: .ds-code-label { display: grid; gap: .35rem; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink, #171719); font-weight: 600; margin: .75rem 0; } .ds-code-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; font: inherit; color: var(--ink, #171719); background: #fff; border: 1px solid #757575; border-radius: .25rem; padding: .65rem .75rem; caret-color: var(--accent, #171719); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-code-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #535353); } .ds-code-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--threat, #85221b); } .ds-code-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #171719); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-code-help { font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.45; margin: -.25rem 0 .5rem; color: var(--muted, #535353); }

components.name: Skip-to-play navigation
components.description: The entry masthead's real anchor, not a pill or invented navigation bar.
components.css: .ds-skip-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--accent, #171719); font-weight: 650; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-skip-play:hover { color: var(--ink, #171719); } .ds-skip-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #171719); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Relationship label
components.description: Non-interactive outlined text role; threat changes currentColor. This does not canonize radar glyph shorthand.
components.css: .ds-relationship { font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; padding: .1rem .4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: .2rem; color: var(--muted, #535353); } .ds-relationship[data-relationship="target"] { color: var(--accent, #171719); } .ds-relationship[data-relationship="threat"] { color: var(--threat, #85221b); }

components.name: Technical disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary interaction; the body is copied from the shipped radar explanation.
components.html:
Radar details

Influence must stay confirmed until the bar fills. Leaving range or losing location quality stops progress.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink, #171719); margin: 1rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d9d9d9); } .ds-disclosure-summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .6rem 0; font-weight: 650; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-disclosure-summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #171719); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure-note { max-width: 70ch; margin: .7rem 0; color: var(--muted, #535353); font-size: .95rem; }

components.css: .ds-player-list { padding-left: 1.5rem; margin: 0; max-height: 18rem; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-color: var(--ink, #171719) transparent; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink, #171719); } .ds-player-row { padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9d9d9); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-player-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: .5rem; } .ds-player-heading { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .25rem .5rem; } .ds-player-heading strong { flex-basis: 100%; } .ds-player-hand { width: 1.7rem; height: 1.7rem; padding: .2rem; margin-inline-end: .45rem; vertical-align: -.45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--faction-scissors, #69b5f5); } .ds-player-faction { font-size: .85rem; } .ds-player-relation { font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; padding: .1rem .4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: .2rem; color: var(--accent, #171719); } .ds-player-distance { margin: 0; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-size: .85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-player-distance strong { font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-distance-qualifier { display: block; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-player-details { margin: 0; } .ds-player-details-summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .6rem 0; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-player-details-summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #171719); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-player-note { margin: .25rem 0; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--muted, #535353); }

components.css: .ds-hud { padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--faction-rock, #eb6256); color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-hud-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #17171966; } .ds-own-faction { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-own-hand { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; flex-shrink: 0; padding: .4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--faction-rock, #eb6256); } .ds-hud-title { margin: 0; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-hud-round { text-align: right; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-round-state { margin: 0; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-round-clock { margin: 0; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-hud { padding: 1rem; } .ds-hud-heading { padding-bottom: .75rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-hud-title, .ds-round-clock { font-size: 2rem; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-hud-heading { gap: .5rem; } .ds-hud-title, .ds-round-clock { font-size: 1.75rem; } }

components.name: Branded entry introduction
components.description: Source-led responsive yellow introduction. The supplied symbol is inlined without changing its paths or viewBox; it is never a text-glyph logo.
components.html:
Change sides.
Keep playing.

An outdoor Rock, Paper, Scissors game for friends.
components.css: .ds-entry-intro { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 3rem; background: var(--faction-paper, #f2cf45); color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; } .ds-entry-title { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-size: 3.75rem; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.04em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-entry-copy { max-width: 30ch; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-entry-mark { display: block; width: 14rem; height: auto; margin: 1.5rem; } @media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 900px) { .ds-entry-intro { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 5rem; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-entry-title { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: .75rem; } .ds-entry-copy { font-size: 1rem; } .ds-entry-mark { width: 5rem; margin: 0; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-entry-intro { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 4rem; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem; } .ds-entry-title { font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.05; margin-bottom: .5rem; } .ds-entry-copy { font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-entry-mark { width: 4rem; margin: 0; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-entry-intro { padding: .75rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 3.5rem; gap: .75rem; } .ds-entry-title { font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-entry-copy { font-size: .85rem; } .ds-entry-mark { width: 3.5rem; } }

components.name: In-game radar frame
components.description: Static frame specimen from the 320-unit SVG. Rings and range labels are functional; dynamic markers and glyph role badges are intentionally not synthesized here.
components.css: .ds-radar-figure { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink, #171719); } .ds-radar-svg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 20rem; height: auto; color: var(--ink, #171719); margin-inline: auto; } .ds-radar-face { fill: var(--accent, #171719); } .ds-radar-ring { fill: none; stroke: #ffffff99; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-radar-axis { fill: none; stroke: #ffffff99; stroke-width: 1; } .ds-range-label { fill: #fff; stroke: var(--ink, #171719); stroke-width: 3; paint-order: stroke; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-radar-compass { fill: var(--ink, #171719); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-radar-you { fill: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-radar-center { fill: #fff; stroke: var(--accent, #171719); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-radar-caption { font-size: .8rem; margin: 0; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-radar-svg { width: min(100%, 17.5rem, 36svh); } } @media (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px) { .ds-radar-svg { width: min(100%, 52svh); } }

narrative.overview:
The app extends the supplied paired-arch identity into a clear, flat interface for outdoor play. Local Hanken Grotesk, original SVG marks, exact faction colors, ink controls, and thin dividers do the work; there is no new world, image comp, authored shipping raster, or splash animation.

This scoped record is authoritative for **app-specific layout, sizing, and controls** in `src/client/`. It inherits marks, palette, font, and identity geometry from [the kit guide](../../brand/DESIGN.md) and [kit assets](../../brand/assets/). The kit's earlier app measurements do not override the current stylesheet recorded here. [Root DESIGN.md](../../DESIGN.md) remains the separate game/system concept; [PRODUCT.md](../../PRODUCT.md) remains product truth. Visitor mode is **Operate**, not a mode imposed on other surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Flat yellow entry and invitation fields; an own-faction field during running and paused play.
Supplied paired arches remain visible on phones; lettering remains artwork.
Named factions and hand SVGs support color; distances and clocks use tabular numerals.
Nearby players, conversion state, and consent controls stay legible; technical detail uses disclosures.
Persistent entry/rules and invitation components preserve input and interaction continuity.

rules.name: The Shared Factions Rule
rules.body: Red stays Rock, yellow stays Paper, and blue stays Scissors. Keep faction names and supplied hand SVGs alongside color.

rules.name: The Readable Pairings Rule
rules.body: Use ink text on white and faction fields; reverse text on ink. White radar labels, halos, and link underlays belong to the ink radar drawing, not a new white-on-faction body-text treatment.

rules.name: The Lettering Is Artwork Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied path wordmark and paired arches; Hanken Grotesk supports the identity, never substitutes for its lettering.

rules.name: The Stable Numbers Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for clocks, distances, conversion readouts, compact in-game room codes, measurements, and history times.

rules.name: The Readout Before Diagnostics Rule
rules.body: Keep faction, clock, nearby players, and conversion state exposed. Put technical location detail and secondary room/host tools in disclosures without removing consent, warnings, safe-play notes, or any host action.

rules.name: The Flat Fields Rule
rules.body: Separate app regions with color and thin dividers, not elevated generic cards. Preserve functional focus outlines and radar halos.

dos: **Do** inherit the exact faction palette, local Hanken Grotesk, and supplied SVG geometry.
**Do** use this app record for current control sizes and breakpoint behavior rather than the kit's earlier app measurements.
**Do** keep arches on phones and stack entry panels throughout 641–900px so the code field remains readable.
**Do** preserve approximate/last-known text, visible consent controls, rules, warnings, safe-play notes, and every host action.
**Do** retain thin dividers, focus outlines, functional circles, and radar halos in the flat system.
donts: **Don't** swap faction meanings, type the wordmark, or redraw the paired arches.
**Don't** add elevated generic cards, decorative raster imagery, or a splash-animation dependency to this app extension.
**Don't** hide distances behind technical disclosures or treat radar positions as conversion confirmation.
**Don't** globalize this app's Operate mode or its yellow entry/lobby composition to unrelated kit surfaces.
**Don't** treat synthesized sidecar swatch strips as new palette tokens or the bounded app finish as a marketing-kit or physical-GPS approval.
